title: VSEPR as $\Phi_1$ minimisation; per-bond energy by bond order
html:
Remark. VSEPR as \Phi_1 minimisation; per-bond energy by bond order

This is the braid-theoretic origin of VSEPR geometry. Minimising electron-pair repulsion is exactly \Phi_1 minimisation over strand orderings. The LP dual formalises the repulsion-minimisation principle as a linear program.

We compare the binding energy per C=O bond with:

  • CO triple bond: \approx 11.09\;\text{eV} \;\mathrm{eV} (3 bonds)
  • CO_2 double bond: \approx 8.28\;\text{eV} \;\mathrm{eV} (2 bonds)
  • The per-bond energy decreases with bond order: 11.09/3 \approx 3.70 versus 8.28/2 \approx 4.14 \;\mathrm{eV} per shared pair.
